props.title: Opinionated React charts for narrative business dashboards.
props.lede: Bars, lines, waterfalls and runways that say what changed, and whether it is on plan.

props.heading: A visual language that reads at a glance

items.title: Hatched is plan
items.text: Stripes mark a plan, a forecast or a reference.

items.title: Solid is actual
items.text: Filled marks are what really happened.

items.title: Pink is loss
items.text: One loud color, saved for what went wrong.

items.title: Targets come first
items.text: The goal is drawn on the chart, not in a footnote.

props.heading: Nine reference dashboards
props.lede: Live examples of each dashboard, rendered from the same code you can copy.

items.caption: Gross margin: weekly result, 12-week trend and what pulls it under target
Jobs by margin: one dot per job, colored by band
Estimate vs actual: cost lines, result and where the profit went
Leakage: profit leaked by week, and by branch and cause
Drill-down: from all leakage to the people and jobs behind it
Margin outlook: actual through September, forecast to December
Usage runway: which accounts run out before reset
Performance: score distribution, pages below threshold and Core Web Vitals

items.title: Accessible by default
items.text: Keyboard navigation, screen reader announcements, a hidden data table and forced-colors support.

items.title: Server Components
items.text: Charts render on the server and stay light on the client.

items.title: Themed with tokens
items.text: Every color, stripe and radius is a --ch-* CSS variable you can override.

items.title: Light and dark
items.text: Follows the system, or force a theme on any ancestor.
